name: NovaTech Labs
description: A 40-person SaaS startup with 8 systems, 18 months of history

documents.title: ADR-001: Use JWT for stateless authentication
documents.content: After evaluating session-based auth and JWT, we decided to use JWT tokens for stateless authentication. JWTs allow horizontal scaling without shared session store. Decision made by Priya after benchmarking at 10k RPS.

documents.title: ADR-002: Migrate from JWT to opaque session tokens (reversal of ADR-001)
documents.content: Following the JWT secret key exposure incident in Q3 2025, we are migrating AuthService from JWT to opaque session tokens with Redis backing. This supersedes ADR-001. All downstream services using JWT validation must update.

documents.title: ADR-003: PostgreSQL as primary store for BillingSystem
documents.content: BillingSystem will use PostgreSQL as its primary datastore. ACID compliance is critical for financial transactions. Schema attached.

documents.title: ADR-004: Migrate BillingSystem to CockroachDB for global scale (supersedes ADR-003)
documents.content: As NovaTech expands to EU and APAC, BillingSystem requires multi-region ACID compliance. We are migrating from single-region PostgreSQL to CockroachDB. This supersedes ADR-003.

documents.title: POL-005: Mobile API rate limiting policy — 50 req/s per user
documents.content: Per the security review, API rate limiting is set to 50 requests per second per authenticated user. This applies to all endpoints.

documents.title: POL-006: Mobile API rate limiting policy v2 — 200 req/s per user (supersedes POL-005)
documents.content: Updated rate limit policy: API rate limiting is now 200 requests per second per authenticated user, as the 50 req/s limit was causing issues for enterprise customers. MobileAPI team requested this change.

documents.title: ADR-007: Adopt gRPC Protocol Buffers for Low-Latency Inter-Service RPCs
documents.content: Evaluation of REST JSON vs gRPC Protobuf for inter-service communication. Benchmarking demonstrates 40% latency reduction. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: RFC-018: TensorRT GPU Accelerated Inference Architecture for RecommendationEngine
documents.content: Proposing migration of model serving to Triton Inference Server with TensorRT-LLM runtimes for sub-20ms inference. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: SPEC-025: Redis Cluster Topology, Sharding, and Automated Failover Policy
documents.content: Architecture specification detailing 6-node Redis cluster deployment with automated replica promotion. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: POL-012: Idempotency Key Specification for Financial API Mutations
documents.content: All mutating payment and billing API requests must submit an Idempotency-Key HTTP header conforming to UUIDv4. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: RUN-033: Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance and Lag Recovery Playbook
documents.content: Operational runbook for diagnosing consumer partition stalls and scaling out consumer worker replicas. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: SEC-015: TLS 1.3 Minimum and Mutual TLS (mTLS) Implementation Guide
documents.content: Zero-trust service mesh policy requiring mTLS between all Kubernetes pods via Linkerd sidecars. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: ADR-019: Apache Iceberg Catalog Integration for Analytics DataLake
documents.content: Migrating raw S3 Parquet tables to Apache Iceberg metadata catalog for ACID transactions and partition evolution. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: POSTMORTEM-042: SearchEngine Elasticsearch Outage Postmortem Analysis
documents.content: Root-cause analysis of the 2-hour search indexing outage caused by shard unbalance during unannounced node drain. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: SPEC-031: Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) Tuning Guidelines
documents.content: Standardizing target CPU and custom request latency metrics for auto-scaling platform microservices. Documented and reviewed by the architecture working group. Approved for production implementation.

documents.title: POL-029: Cross-Region Database Backup and Point-in-Time Recovery SLO

decisions.title: Use JWT for AuthService authentication
decisions.rationale: Stateless, scalable, well-understood. JWT allows horizontal scaling without shared session store. Benchmarked at 10k RPS.

decisions.title: Migrate AuthService from JWT to opaque session tokens
decisions.rationale: JWT secret key exposure in security incident. All downstream services must update their auth validation.

decisions.title: Use PostgreSQL as primary store for BillingSystem
decisions.rationale: ACID compliance required for financial transactions. PostgreSQL is battle-tested.

decisions.title: Migrate BillingSystem to CockroachDB
decisions.rationale: Global expansion to EU/APAC requires multi-region ACID. CockroachDB provides this natively.

decisions.title: Enforce 50 req/s rate limit in MobileAPI
decisions.rationale: Per security policy doc, all APIs must enforce 50 req/s limit. MobileAPI implementation to use token bucket.

decisions.title: Redesign AuthService for Kubernetes HPA compatibility
decisions.rationale: Current stateful sessions incompatible with horizontal pod autoscaling. Migrate to token-based auth.

decisions.title: Adopt gRPC for internal service communications
decisions.rationale: Low latency binary protocol with HTTP/2 multiplexing reduces p99 RPC overhead by 40% compared to REST JSON.

decisions.title: Migrate RecommendationEngine from PyTorch CPU to TensorRT GPU serving
decisions.rationale: Reduces inference latency from 180ms to 18ms under 5k RPS peak load. Requires NVIDIA T4 inference instances.

decisions.title: Deploy Redis Cluster for shared session caching in MobileAPI
decisions.rationale: Distributed in-memory store with automatic sharding and replication to eliminate single-point-of-failure in session lookup.

decisions.title: Adopt OpenTelemetry distributed tracing across all microservices
decisions.rationale: Standardizes trace context propagation across Go, Python, and Node.js services with export to Jaeger/Datadog.

decisions.title: Enforce TLS 1.3 and mutual TLS (mTLS) in service mesh
decisions.rationale: Zero-trust network architecture requirement. Eliminates unencrypted intra-cluster VPC traffic.

decisions.title: Transition PaymentProcessor pipeline to Kafka event-driven architecture
decisions.rationale: Decouples synchronous checkout flow from downstream invoice and accounting ledger generation.

decisions.title: Migrate DataLake storage format from raw S3 Parquet to Apache Iceberg
decisions.rationale: Provides ACID transactions, hidden partitioning, and time-travel table snapshotting for analytics queries.

decisions.title: Standardize on PostgreSQL 16 read-replicas for SearchEngine index feeder
decisions.rationale: Reduces replication lag to under 50ms and prevents analytical ETL queries from impacting transactional database.

decisions.title: Implement OAuth2 PKCE authorization flow for Mobile clients
decisions.rationale: Mitigates authorization code interception attacks on public mobile clients without embedding client secrets.

decisions.title: Deprecate legacy REST v1 endpoints in favor of unified GraphQL schema
decisions.rationale: Eliminates over-fetching on mobile networks and provides typed contract schema for frontend clients.

decisions.title: Standardize Prometheus alerting on p99 service latency exceeding 250ms
decisions.rationale: Establishes unified SLO thresholds across all customer-facing microservices.

decisions.title: Enforce SOC2 compliance audit logging across all auth credential mutations
decisions.rationale: Mandatory regulatory compliance requirement. All password resets, token grants, and role changes must emit immutable audit events.

decisions.title: Deploy Cloudflare Argo Smart Routing for edge API caching
decisions.rationale: Optimizes routing over tier-1 internet backbone, reducing transatlantic latency by 32%.

decisions.title: Transition database backups to continuous WAL archiving with point-in-time recovery
decisions.rationale: Reduces RPO to under 5 minutes and enables exact timestamp database restoration during data corruption incidents.

decisions.title: Implement circuit breaker pattern on downstream payment gateway integrations
decisions.rationale: Prevents cascading thread pool exhaustion when third-party card processors experience degraded response times.

decisions.title: Standardize on Golang for high-throughput authentication microservices
decisions.rationale: Eliminates Python GIL bottlenecks and provides predictable memory footprint under 20k concurrent WebSocket connections.

decisions.title: Adopt Apache Spark on Kubernetes for distributed ML feature engineering
decisions.rationale: Replaces single-node Pandas batch jobs with horizontally scalable distributed dataframe compute.

decisions.title: Enforce Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) and HSTS headers on all web origins
decisions.rationale: Protects against cross-site scripting (XSS) and SSL stripping attacks.

decisions.title: Implement zero-downtime blue/green deployments via Kubernetes Argo Rollouts
decisions.rationale: Automates canary analysis with automated rollback on error rate spikes exceeding 0.5%.

decisions.title: Migrate background worker queue from RabbitMQ to AWS SQS with Dead Letter Queues
decisions.rationale: Managed queue service reduces operational maintenance overhead and provides automatic exponential retry backoff.

decisions.title: Standardize API versioning using Accept headers instead of URI path prefixes
decisions.rationale: Follows RESTful resource identification best practices and avoids URL route fragmentation.

decisions.title: Adopt Terraform and GitOps pipeline for cloud infrastructure management
decisions.rationale: Eliminates manual AWS console changes and ensures all VPC, RDS, and EKS resources are declared in version control.

decisions.title: Implement distributed rate limiting with Redis sliding-window algorithm
decisions.rationale: Prevents boundary burst exploitation common in fixed-window rate limiters.

decisions.title: Transition notification dispatch to async batching with priority queues
decisions.rationale: Ensures transactional 2FA SMS and password reset emails are not delayed by bulk marketing email broadcasts.

decisions.title: Adopt Elasticsearch synonym filters and BM25 scoring for search relevance
decisions.rationale: Improves product catalog search recall by 28% for multi-word queries.

decisions.title: Implement database connection pooling with PgBouncer for high-concurrency microservices
decisions.rationale: Maintains stable database server CPU utilization by capping active PostgreSQL backend server connections at 100.

decisions.title: Enforce immutable Docker container images with distroless base layers
decisions.rationale: Minimizes container attack surface and eliminates OS package manager vulnerabilities.

decisions.title: Adopt Vector embeddings with FAISS for semantic recommendation candidate filtering
decisions.rationale: Augments collaborative filtering with deep semantic embedding similarity search.

decisions.title: Standardize on UUIDv7 for database primary keys to preserve B-tree insertion locality
decisions.rationale: Time-ordered UUIDs prevent B-tree fragmentation while maintaining distributed unique key generation.

decisions.title: Implement automated chaos engineering drills with Chaos Mesh in staging
decisions.rationale: Validates pod anti-affinity and zone redundancy against spontaneous node termination.

decisions.title: Transition cron job scheduler to Kubernetes CronJobs with concurrency policy Forbid
decisions.rationale: Prevents overlapping batch job executions during long-running billing reconciliation runs.

decisions.title: Enforce encrypted Amazon EBS volumes with customer-managed KMS keys
decisions.rationale: Ensures cryptographic data-at-rest protection conforming to ISO 27001 standards.

decisions.title: Adopt WebAuthn and FIDO2 passkeys for enterprise single sign-on
decisions.rationale: Eliminates credential phishing risks through public-key cryptography hardware tokens.

decisions.title: Implement client-side response caching with ETag HTTP validation headers
decisions.rationale: Reduces ingress bandwidth usage and database read queries for unchanged catalog resources.

decisions.title: Migrate metric collection from StatsD to Prometheus pull-based scraping
decisions.rationale: Provides multi-dimensional metric labels and dynamic Kubernetes service discovery.

decisions.title: Standardize error response schema adhering to RFC 7807 Problem Details
decisions.rationale: Unifies machine-readable error codes and human-readable error descriptions across all services.

decisions.title: Adopt AWS KMS envelope encryption for sensitive payment card tokenization
decisions.rationale: Ensures plaintext decryption keys never persist in application runtime memory or persistent storage.

decisions.title: Implement automated dead-letter queue replay tool with replay verification checks
decisions.rationale: Enables safe re-processing of failed payment webhook deliveries following downstream outages.

decisions.title: Transition SearchEngine from self-hosted cluster to managed AWS OpenSearch Service
decisions.rationale: Offloads cluster maintenance, storage auto-expansion, and version upgrades to AWS managed infrastructure.

decisions.title: Deploy automated vulnerability scanning with Trivy in CI/CD container build pipeline
decisions.rationale: Blocks pull request merging on any high or critical CVE detections in application dependencies.

decisions.title: Standardize structured JSON logging with correlation IDs across all microservices
decisions.rationale: Enables seamless end-to-end request tracing across distributed service boundaries in Datadog.

decisions.title: Implement automated database schema migrations with Flyway in deployment pipelines
decisions.rationale: Guarantees deterministic, version-controlled database DDL schema evolutions.

decisions.title: Enforce API contract testing with Pact between MobileAPI and backend microservices
decisions.rationale: Catches breaking API schema changes before staging environment deployments.

decisions.title: Adopt Apache Kafka compacted topics for service configuration broadcast
decisions.rationale: Enables real-time dynamic configuration updates without requiring application pod restarts.
